# URL

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/url` (default export). String subclass validating absolute URLs; renders as a link. The module also exports `isValidUrl` and a `CardWithURL` helper card.

## Usage
```ts
import URLField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/url';
```

Example: value `"https://boxel.ai"`
